fails.text: Well. That was a very expensive nap.
fails.reason: On a lost run, 'a very expensive nap' mocks the failure itself, i.e. the player's performance, rather than one of Rook's plans; the 'Well.' opener also softens Vesna's clipped style.
fails.suggestion: That plan just joined the Ceres job.

fails.text: Kessler-Voss Smart Consoles: innovation, delivered straight to your doorstep!
fails.reason: Console drop is a Rigs action, so the line is aimed at intruders and must be bureaucratic, not propaganda (label and text both wrong); it also presents the Rigs' console as a Kessler-Voss product, against the lore mechanic table. Change both the label (to bureaucratic) and the text.
fails.suggestion: Unauthorized network access point detected. Incident logged for review.

fails.text: Unauthorized console retrieval will be logged under Form 27-B.
fails.reason: number-not-in-excerpt: number "27" does not appear in an excerpt of this item's log entries

fails.text: Surprise! A Kessler-Voss Rewards Crate has arrived for valued guests!
fails.reason: The chest is for the intruders, so propaganda to them breaks the bureaucratic-toward-threats register, and 'valued guests' welcomes trespassers instead of treating them as unauthorized personnel. Change both the label (to bureaucratic) and the text.
fails.suggestion: Unclaimed cargo detected. Removal by unauthorized personnel constitutes theft.

fails.text: Security response dispatched. Compliance is mandatory and appreciated.
fails.reason: Bureaucratic register matches the label, but 'Compliance is mandatory' demands the player comply, i.e. stop, instead of stating what the company does.
fails.suggestion: Security response dispatched. Unauthorized personnel will be processed.

fails.text: Kessler-Voss Safety Team is coming to meet you!
fails.reason: Propaganda aimed at intruders during a robot attack breaks T6 (label and text both wrong), and a 'Safety Team coming to meet you' reads as company humans on site. Change both the label (to bureaucratic) and the text.
fails.suggestion: Security units deployed. Unauthorized personnel flagged for removal.

fails.text: Your premium departure experience awaits. Thank you for visiting!
fails.reason: The shuttle is the Rigs' extraction craft, so this is aimed at intruders and must be bureaucratic, not propaganda (label and text both wrong); 'premium departure experience' also presents the shuttle as a company service. Change both the label (to bureaucratic) and the text.
fails.suggestion: Unregistered craft detected on claim. Departure will be billed.

fails.text: Say hello to my little friend, but louder.
fails.reason: Keeps Scarface's 'Say hello to my little friend' word for word and only tacks on 'but louder'; barely changed, so it is still the same line.
fails.suggestion: Say hello to my little payload.

fails.text: Go ahead, make my day. Repeatedly.
fails.reason: Keeps Dirty Harry's 'Go ahead, make my day' word for word and only adds 'Repeatedly.'; barely changed.
fails.suggestion: Go ahead, make my barrel's day.

fails.text: Feeling lucky, punk? Because I do.
fails.reason: Keeps Dirty Harry's 'Feeling lucky, punk?' (the common misquote) nearly intact and adds 'Because I do', which is also ungrammatical; barely changed.
fails.suggestion: Feeling lucky, scrap pile? I am.

fails.text: I'll be back. Eventually. Sturdier, too.
fails.reason: Keeps Terminator's 'I'll be back' word for word and only adds two afterthoughts; barely changed.

fails.text: Get to the choppa, but I'm already there.
fails.reason: Keeps Predator's 'Get to the choppa' word for word and adds a tail; barely changed, and a chopper has no place in the asteroid setting.
fails.suggestion: Get to the shuttla! Beat you there.
